# Pakt — Offline Voice Translator for Travel

> Pakt is an offline voice and camera translation app for travelers, built by Lingofonex. 100 languages, voice output in 49, on-device — no cloud required, no signal needed.

Publisher: Lingofonex (https://www.lingofonex.com)
App brand: Pakt (alternate name: "Pakt by Lingofonex")
Primary use case: offline voice + text + camera (OCR) translation for travel
Languages supported: 100 (NLLB-200 NMT)
Voice output (TTS): 49 languages
Voice input (ASR): 85 languages
Pricing model: one-time purchase packs + Weekly Pass; no subscription
Privacy posture: on-device translation, no cloud calls, no analytics on translation content

## Localization

Every page is available in 23 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Czech, Romanian, Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish, Arabic, Persian, Hindi, Bengali, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese. Hreflang clusters connect all 23 plus an `x-default` pointing at the English variant.

## What Pakt is not

- Not a real-time conversation translator that requires WiFi
- Not a cloud-backed translation service
- Not a subscription product (one-time packs + an optional Weekly Pass)
- Not an OCR-only or voice-only app — supports text, voice, and camera input
